title: Injective stalk maps from a dense etale source open into a target with domain stalks
statement: Let $X,Y$ be schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], with $Y$ locally Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Assume each stalk of $Y$ is a domain (a nonzero commutative ring with no zero divisors). Let $f:X\to Y$ and let $V\subseteq Y$ be open such that $f^{-1}V$ is dense in $X$ and the restriction of $f$ over $V$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]. For every $x\in X$, the ring map $\mathcal O_{Y,f(x)}\to\mathcal O_{X,x}$ is injective. Finiteness, source normality and integral closedness are not required.

proof.text: For an integral target, represent a germ r killed by f.stalkMap x as the germ of a section s on U. Naturality gives zero germ of f.app U s at x. The germ_eq theorem gives an open W around x on which this pullback is zero. Density supplies z in W with f(z) in V. Its stalk map is flat because the restricted etale morphism is flat; morphismRestrictStalkMap transports this flatness.

A flat local stalk map is faithfully flat and injective, by Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_flat_of_isLocalHom and FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective. Thus s has zero germ at f(z). Injectivity of germs on an integral scheme gives s=0 and hence r=0. This is the fully proved private helper stalkMap_injective_of_integral_dense_flat.

The proved source instance IsLocallyNoetherian.locallyConnectedSpace makes each connected component C of Y open. Transfer the domain stalk condition across its open-immersion stalk isomorphisms. The proved irreducibleSpace_of_isDomain_stalk makes C irreducible; domain stalks make it reduced, hence integral. These are the direct applications in hC and the five local instances of the Lean proof.

Restrict f to the component C containing f(x). Dense.preimage along the open source inclusion preserves density of the original etale source open. Transport flatness of the original restricted stalk maps to the C-restricted maps using the two morphismRestrictStalkMap isomorphisms. Apply the private integral-target helper and transport injectivity back with RingHom.injective_respectsIso.arrow_mk_iso_iff.

mathlib_searches.query: A scheme morphism with dense etale locus into a locally Noetherian normal scheme has injective stalk maps
Dense etale locus of a scheme morphism to a locally Noetherian scheme with domain stalks implies every stalk map is injective
mathlib_searches.results: The search found stalkMap_injective_of_isOpenMap_of_injective, requiring unrelated global injectivity assumptions, and germ-injective scheme results. No matching theorem.

AffineScheme stalkMap_injective reduces to section germs; ClosedImmersion has an unrelated injectivity theorem. No dense-etale stalk injectivity result. Source Noetherian and FunctionField provide the proved component and germ ingredients.

lean.statement:
theorem dense_etale_stalkMap_injective_of_domain_stalks {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hY : ∀ y : Y, IsDomain (Y.presheaf.stalk y))
    (V : Y.Opens) (hdense : Dense (↑(f ⁻¹ᵁ V) : Set X))
    (hetale : Etale (f ∣_ V)) (x : X) :
    Function.Injective (f.stalkMap x).hom
